notes: This contract records the portable IEEE 1516.1 TCK shape for a single timestamped Update Attribute Values invocation containing one timestamp-order attribute and one receive-order attribute. It observes the receive-order reflection before Retract, retracts the invocation's queued timestamped effect, and verifies that the delivered receive-order result remains while the timestamped reflection is suppressed. The provider, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation are adapter supplied. This scenario is a focused API behavior check, not a conformance claim.
